operads/application/autopoiesis/harveste: Full body reviewed. Directory bytes are archived through a supplied content-addressed store with snapshot Merkle roots; pre-clean verifies archived size/hash before calling a clear_verified port. mine_teamwork does not inspect document contents: four filename patterns emit fixed HIGH-confidence skill proposals and fixed antibody text bound to selected source hashes. teamwork_dir is unused in mining. Authority remains None and these are candidates, so archive custody and filename matches establish neither learned efficacy nor semantic evidence. Reusable mechanism is content custody and guarded cleanup, with heuristic candidate discovery clearly separated from later evaluation.
operads/application/autopoiesis/learning: Full body reviewed. Port-driven learning workflow suppresses recursive autopoiesis jobs, deduplicates lessons, bounds source hash sets and allowed paths, requires motivating/applicable/non-applicable unique case IDs, evaluates baseline and candidate, verifies revision, and publishes only if a motivating failure improves, all after-cases pass, and agent/workflow/skill artifact is invoked in at least one after-case. Model-dependent suites repeat three trials. oracle_hash binds cases only, while saved oracle also contains commands, allowed paths and model_dependent; whole-policy immutability is not established by the local recheck. VALIDATED explicitly records deployed false and subsequent use NOT_OBSERVED. Finite examples and invocation presence are not general causal efficacy; injected ports own execution isolation and CAS integrity.
operads/application/commands/compile_pro: Full body reviewed. Unit-of-work catalog lookup invokes projection port, hashes emitted UTF-8 payload and returns generated-ID DTO. Reusable provenance wrapper; no projection semantics, law proof or execution authority is established here.
operads/application/commands/verify_cata: Full body reviewed. Catalog verification checks operation identifiers and resolves composition root/child IDs. It invokes the strict-operad port only for compositions with resolved nonempty slots, then reports catalog operation count as total_operations_verified. This is bounded catalog/link/port validation, not exhaustive identity/associativity checking; a zero-child composition receives no composition-port call. Adequacy depends on DTO constructors and selected port implementation.
operads/application/governance_digest/ap: Full body reviewed. operads/application/governance_digest/le: Full body reviewed. operads/application/governance_digest/re: Full body reviewed. Lexical normalization removes dot/dot-dot components and rejects exact case-sensitive protected component names; no realpath/symlink or filesystem case normalization is applied. On a case-insensitive filesystem uppercase protected names are a potential counterexample to the named directory exclusion. write_receipt creates parents and writes payload after this lexical guard; no protected file was accessed or written during review.

operads/application/governance_digest/te: Full body reviewed. Small text locator library hashes UTF-8 text, identifies heading spans and first pipe table, measures pre/post anchors, enforces unique literal matches, and rejects intersecting half-open edit intervals before assembling from one original. operads/application/immune_guards.py: Full body reviewed. Application-level injected screening wraps pure planar substitution, translates exceptions into typed errors, refuses blocked findings, and leaves mathematical composition separate from external policy. Exact policy type/enforcement flag gates workflows; thymus uses nonblank literal triggers or skill name and classifies blocked refusal as autoimmune. Policy-relative screening is not detector adequacy, independent evidence or a general mathematical law.
operads/application/governance_digest/di: Full body reviewed in three complete ranges after invalidating one truncated emission. Deterministic read-only classifier checks required pattern metadata, mutual dual references and duplicate IDs, separates boilerplate recurrence/custody from lesson candidates, identifies audit GO/blocker records, and emits only pinned pre-state repair proposals. It correctly states repeated file touches are recurrence rather than anti-pattern evidence. Findings such as audit_pass and complete lesson are classifications of supplied text, not re-executed validations. Pattern citation coverage is derived from registered repair specifications, not an exhaustive live rule citation parser. Exact byte hashes and trusted snapshots are prerequisites; source/doc path strings use lexical, case-sensitive matching. Reusable bounded evidence triage and fingerprinted proposal generation with authority None.
